findings.old_text: DayZ Server is single-threaded for gameplay logic. Clock speed matters more than core count.
findings.reason: Replication workers and generic parallel-task processing do not prove that gameplay/script logic is multithreaded; the original sentence is expressly limited to gameplay logic.

findings.old_text: This is normal. DayZ Server is single-threaded. Do not run multiple server instances on the same core -- use processor affinity or separate machines.
findings.final_new_text: High utilization on one core can reflect a main-thread bottleneck, but the server also uses parallel tasks and can use multithreaded replication. Check server FPS and profile the workload before assigning affinity; size replication workers through `dayzsettings.xml` when `multithreadedReplication` is enabled.
findings.reason: The unqualified whole-server statement conflicts with documented replication workers and -cpuCount parallel-task processing; the repair does not claim gameplay logic itself is multithreaded.
